note: All 165 bundles (all Middle Irish pivots: Acallam, In Cath Catharda, Feis Tighe Chonáin, Aislinge Meic Con Glinne etc.) read; partners overwhelmingly Greek prose (Galen, Plutarch, Diodorus), with some OHG, ON, Skt epic. No defensible inherited phraseology: candidate overlaps (fer..gona ~ para-vira-ha; mathair bhunaidh .i. talam in the Lucan Antaeus episode; scíath ~ shchit in Igor; father-and-mother merisms; eilit/cú ~ elaphos/kyon in a deer-hunt) were generic, translated from Latin, or not in congruent syntax/context. No claims.
